title: Central Maine’s Premier Residence!
subtitle: Entire home in Pittsfield, Maine
host: Hosted by Haakon. Superhost. 5 years hosting.
highlights: In Pittsfield, a central Maine hub. A central Maine base about 30 minutes from Bangor, Waterville, and Skowhegan, with I-95 right nearby.
Full arcade and karaoke lounge. A full arcade with Big Buck Hunter and Ms. Pac-Man, plus a karaoke lounge for after-hours fun.
Hawk goes above and beyond. Guests consistently praise Hawk as responsive, accommodating, and proactive throughout their stays.
opening: Grand Luxury meets nonstop fun-black marble counters, full old-school arcade, candy Crane, Karaoke lounge. Enjoy sporting with friends on Big Buck Hunter! Sleeps 10. Direct snowmobile/ATV trail access+ 60-sec to I-95 ramp. Perfect highway stopover or multi-day adventure base.
space: Our goal is to create a space where families can experience joy and inclusion with maximum participation. Free parking. One bedroom downstairs for the disabled or elderly, next to the downstairs bathroom and laundry. A stocked kitchen. A connected living room and kitchen. A mini karaoke lounge. An arcade with full-size games such as Big Buck Hunter and Mrs. Pac-Man pub table. A king suite upstairs with its own bathroom and 3 other bedrooms that share a large bathroom. A grill, tables and fire ring on the patio. A large yard for touch football, croquet and cornhole. A peaceful neighborhood. An enclosed area for a pet. Closet space in every room and a large area for coats and boots.
access: Every part of the property is able to be enjoyed by the guests except for the two big garages, which are storage, and the she-shed, which is under development for next summer.
location: At the Pine Tree you are exactly in the middle of everywhere. It is 30-45 minutes from every cool attraction in Central Maine. Bangor, Skowhegan and Waterville are all just 30 minutes away. Augusta is about 40 minutes.
